ios.desc:
Crew Chief is your all-in-one vehicle management app. Connect a Bluetooth OBD2 scanner to read diagnostic trouble codes, view live engine data, and get AI-powered diagnostic reports with repair guidance and cost estimates.

DIAGNOSTICS & SCANNING
• Read and clear diagnostic trouble codes (DTCs) via Bluetooth OBD2
• View live engine data — RPM, speed, coolant temp, fuel trim, and more
• Get AI diagnostic reports with severity ratings, repair steps, and part recommendations
• Look up any OBD2 code with detailed explanations

VEHICLE MANAGEMENT
• Track unlimited vehicle types — cars, trucks, SUVs, motorcycles, boats, tractors, RVs, ATVs, and more
• Store photos, documents, and service records
• Set maintenance reminders and track tasks
• Manage your entire fleet from one dashboard

DREAM CARS
• Set alerts for vehicles you're looking for
• Search eBay Motors and marketplace listings
• Save and compare listings

PROJECTS
• Track maintenance tasks across all vehicles
• Organize by priority and status
• Estimate costs and schedule due dates

Works with any ELM327-compatible Bluetooth OBD2 scanner. Free to use with optional Pro subscription for unlimited AI diagnostics.

quotes.text:
I've been building the most advanced automotive diagnostic app on the market

I used to be a mechanic, and spend a lot of my free time working on project vehicles, motorcycles, tractors, trucks etc. I wanted a tool to track the tasks I needed done, then a way to easily access VIN info for parts search, then I DMV records, and finally built an iphone app to scan the OBD2 diagnostic codes and hook them up to a custom ai diagnostic prompt.

It's been a blast to work on, I need to focus on marketing it and get some users that aren't close friends, but it's been serving my purposes this summer so far.

I've seen nothing with anywhere close to this depth of diagnostic reporting.
